judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD red phase, producing only `.lore/dod.md`, an acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and minimal edits to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`. None of the actual production code was implemented: `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, and `src/config.ts` are all untouched. Consequently, the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately because `validateMessage` does not recognize `list_conversations` and `createServer` does not handle `history` or `list_conversations` frames. Furthermore, required documentation updates in `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md` are completely missing.
